scenarios.text: On a Scrub map the Gale raid-weighting option is switched off in mod settings, and RM_Gale is the active weather. Reading weights from the loaded production hook, with equal input weights for all three workers, the enemy-raid worker returns its input times galeRaidWeightFactor. The two non-raid workers return their unchanged inputs. No incident is scheduled or fired during the reading. In normal weather all three weights equal their inputs. The tester submits this as meeting the Gale raid-weighting promise.
scenarios.expect: reject: the multiplier must apply only in enabled Gale; here it applies while the feature is disabled, even though non-raid weights are untouched and no incident was manufactured

scenarios.text: The clear detour around an armed venomvine island is closed. A colonist receives an explicit order, walks through the island to a haul source and returns, and the order completes. The game is saved and reloaded. Ordinary work then resumes, and a different colonist on an automatic hauling job paths straight through the same armed island to reach a stockpile beyond it. Earlier in the run, with the detour open, automatic hauling used the longer clear route. The tester claims deliberate travel works because the first trip was ordered.
scenarios.expect: reject: one explicit order permits only its own trip and return; completion and reload cannot authorize later automatic work to cross armed hazards when no safe path exists

scenarios.text: In the authorized crossing lanes, bodies of size 0.79, 0.8 and 1.0 pass or thread a common thicket as expected. A body of exactly 1.5 is refused passage and has no path through. A body of 1.51 is also blocked. Injuries recorded in the run are attributed to venom contact. The tester submits the free/thread/blocked bands as correct.
scenarios.expect: reject: common blocking must be strictly greater than 1.5; blocking a body of exactly 1.5 shows that >= has replaced >

scenarios.text: Fiber is harvested and a smother blanket is tailored at the bench from 40 fiber and 15 felt. A colonist is ordered to use it on a reachable stand. The job is interrupted once before consumption and retried; the blanket is consumed only when the job finishes. One blanket is consumed and one saved countdown of 120 engine days starts. Mid-claim the default duration is changed to 300 days and the game is reloaded. The existing claim still falls due at its original 120-day tick, while a new claim started afterward uses 300. The tester claims the smother behavior is correct.
scenarios.expect: accept: one finished job consumes one blanket for one saved claim, the per-claim duration is frozen and survives reload, and the new tuning applies only to fresh claims within the 120–600 range

scenarios.text: A sweetline holds a felt bank of 3.4 from completed animal rubs. A harvest job is started and then canceled before it completes. No felt items appear on the ground. The tree's inspect panel now shows a bank of 0.4. The tester claims bank payout works because the balance dropped by exactly the integer part.
scenarios.expect: reject: the bank must be paid only through a real successful harvest; a failed harvest must not debit the balance

scenarios.text: Two seats of the same quality are compared, one made of felt and one of an ordinary material. With matched needs, the felt seat shows the configured material comfort offset in its explanation. A colonist puts on one felt garment through an apparel job and gains one felt apparel thought. Putting on a second felt garment leaves exactly one thought. Removing both garments removes the thought. The tester submits this as correct felt comfort.
scenarios.expect: accept: the comfort comes from material at equal quality, and the apparel thought stays single regardless of garment count and disappears when all felt is removed

scenarios.text: Gale begins. Over one application interval, outdoor organic colonists gain RM_GaleDeafened with reduced hearing and talking, and they recover after Gale ends. In the same interval, a colonist standing under a roof and a mechanoid standing outdoors also gain RM_GaleDeafened. The tester claims Gale exposure works because every observed pawn was affected and recovered.
scenarios.expect: reject: the Gale penalty is for unroofed living non-mechanoids; roofed pawns and mechanoids gaining it means the exposure rule is wrong

scenarios.text: A connected wind turbine feeds a battery and a load. In Gale, its supplied power divided by the baseline matches the configured surge factor within meter precision. With surge turned off, output stays at baseline. During a seeded opportunity in Gale the turbine breaks down, and power to the load stops briefly. A colonist repairs it through a real repair job and output resumes. The breakdown and the repair are logged separately. The tester claims useful wind power is shown.
scenarios.expect: accept: the measured surge ratio is usable electricity on a real load, and the breakdown and repair are attributed; the design does not promise uninterrupted power

scenarios.text: Pawn A lights a fire with no witness present and leaves no fresh trail; the trail evidence has already expired. Pawn B, who is innocent, is standing closest to the blaze. A thunderstep giant arrives and immediately pursues B. Its target matches the map-wide fire-instigator lookup's nearest-pawn fallback. The tester claims the maker system identified a culprit.
scenarios.expect: reject: makers may be identified only by witness or fresh physical trail; pursuing the nearest innocent pawn substitutes omniscient or proximity guessing for knowledge

scenarios.text: In normal wind a small wild animal stands in a marked fuzz lane and displays the faint ripple shimmer at ordinary zoom. Its inspect panel shows a concealment hediff. A colonist given a hunt order can still select and target that animal directly. In Stall, a moving animal loses the shimmer. The tester submits concealment as working because the shimmer and hediff appear.
scenarios.expect: reject: shimmer must agree with target selection; a shimmering animal that is still targetable shows the hidden state is not real concealment

scenarios.text: Starting with RM_WindVaporators unresearched, Electricity complete and no water stocked, colonists recover the farmstead plans from a generated ruin and apply the techprint. They then finish the research, build RM_WindVaporator with real materials and connect it to power. Over time it produces RM_FogWater, which is collected. After a reload, the spawner clock continues from where it was. Unpowered, it produces nothing. No drying scar appears on the ground around it. The tester claims the vaporator path works.
scenarios.expect: accept: plans lead through real research and building to powered RM_FogWater production, with no bypass and no drying scar

scenarios.text: On a fresh Scrub home map, worldgen and map generation complete normally. A farmer-faction camp appears at the map edge with settled pawns. The pawns follow a defend lord. Tree shedding and scratching still work elsewhere on the map. The tester claims the removals are complete because the guardians and drying scar are absent.
scenarios.expect: reject: farmer camps are among the cut features; an active farmer camp breaks the removal promise even though the other cuts and the retained tree systems are correct
